Text.Text: The school is finished. Carry the form with its restraint intact; that matters more than a title. You've finished my Red Bloom trials. I have no further work for you here.
The backroom trials require rank 50 in Twin Blade. Reach it before you take this job. Almost ready is a dangerous way to enter a ring.

The backroom school is teaching my paired-blade form without its restraint. Recover the ledger so I can identify the people booking those fights. Defeat six Red Bloom Adepts in Smuggler's Moon, Fight Club Backrooms. Their defeat secures the Red Bloom Backroom Bout Ledger; bring it back to me here in Smuggler's Moon, Casino. I'll give you the Smuggler's Moon Fight Club Backrooms Key when you accept. Complete all five trials to earn the right to train Red Bloom.

Here's the Smuggler's Moon Fight Club Backrooms Key. Use '[Back Rooms]' in Smuggler's Moon, Fight Club. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat six Red Bloom Adepts, then return with the Red Bloom Backroom Bout Ledger.
Two cuts. They open together, or they're just cuts. Most people spend a career teaching two blades to agree. The bloom is what happens after they stop needing to. That's all I'll say standing up.

Mine, once removed. Someone in the backrooms taught my form from watching my old bouts. Kept the shape. Dropped the rules. The rules were the part that cost me something. Six students so far. There will be sixty if the school stays open.
Names. Odds. Which bouts were fixed to end in a funeral. I left the circuit so my form would stop filling graves. The ledger will tell me how far behind I already am.
Defeat six Red Bloom Adepts in Smuggler's Moon, Fight Club Backrooms. Their defeat secures the Red Bloom Backroom Bout Ledger; bring it back to me here in Smuggler's Moon, Casino.
You've defeated six Red Bloom Adepts. Let me see the Red Bloom Backroom Bout Ledger.
The training record is back. We can see what went wrong. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the specialist trial when you're ready.

The specialists are running the ring's shock regulator. Bring it back and stop those bouts. Defeat five Red Bloom Specialists in Smuggler's Moon, Fight Club Backrooms. Their defeat secures the Red Bloom Ring Shock Regulator; bring it back to me here in Smuggler's Moon, Casino.
Your key still grants access to Smuggler's Moon, Fight Club Backrooms. Defeat five Red Bloom Specialists to secure the Red Bloom Ring Shock Regulator, then return to me.
Like me, if you'd only ever seen me angry. They'll pair on you -- one high, one low, both patient. Don't watch the blades. Watch the feet. And never let two of them agree on a rhythm.

That regulator hung over my last title bout. It cut the current the instant I dropped my opponent -- saved her life. Someone rewired mercy into a goad. I'd like it back on my wall, ugly and honest. That's all.
A bout I won. The crowd wanted the second cut. I gave it. She was nineteen. That's the whole story anyone is owed, including you. My rules exist so it stays the only one.
Defeat five Red Bloom Specialists in Smuggler's Moon, Fight Club Backrooms. Their defeat secures the Red Bloom Ring Shock Regulator; bring it back to me here in Smuggler's Moon, Casino.
You've defeated five Red Bloom Specialists. Let me see the Red Bloom Ring Shock Regulator.
That equipment no longer serves their drills. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the warden trial when you're ready.

The warden protects the school. Recover his pit sigil and break that protection. Defeat the Red Bloom Warden in Smuggler's Moon, Fight Club Backrooms. Their defeat secures the Red Bloom Cracked Pit Sigil; bring it back to me here in Smuggler's Moon, Casino. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Smuggler's Moon, Fight Club Backrooms, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Red Bloom Warden. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. After the fight, return with the Red Bloom Cracked Pit Sigil.

I broke his sigil with the last clean bloom I ever threw. He bowed. The crowd never understood that bow. He didn't keep the broken sigil out of shame -- he kept it as a promise that no one would pass him carelessly again. When you knock, he'll already know whose student you are.

Because he'd let me pass. Whatever's left of that circuit still bows to me, and a door that opens for your name proves nothing and fixes less. It has to be someone the backrooms owe nothing. And if I went down those stairs, I'm not sure which of us I'd be by the bottom.

Yes. I recommend two companions for the Red Bloom Warden fight. That's advice for a dangerous encounter, not an entry requirement. Gather your party before calling the challenge; a second pair of hands can keep a bad opening from ending the fight.

Defeat the Red Bloom Warden in Smuggler's Moon, Fight Club Backrooms. Their defeat secures the Red Bloom Cracked Pit Sigil; bring it back to me here in Smuggler's Moon, Casino. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Red Bloom Warden. Let me see the Red Bloom Cracked Pit Sigil.
The warden's watch is over. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the inner circle trial when you're ready.

The four running the circuit still hold its payout chit. Take it so we can close their fight book. Defeat four members of the Red Bloom Inner Circle in Smuggler's Moon, Fight Club Backrooms. Their defeat secures the Red Bloom Promoter's Payout Chit; bring it back to me here in Smuggler's Moon, Casino.
Your key still grants access to Smuggler's Moon, Fight Club Backrooms. Defeat four members of the Red Bloom Inner Circle to secure the Red Bloom Promoter's Payout Chit, then return to me.

A counter-fighter who waits better than most people breathe. A pair who share one tempo -- kill the tempo, not the pair, whichever body you can reach first. And a big one who thinks pain is a currency he's rich in. They'll come staggered; the promoter pays per rescue. Keep your two close anyway. Staggered becomes together when money is dying.

My title. Someone is wearing it. She took my name off the boards and put the bloom back to work in the deep pit, the way the crowd always wanted it from me. I'm told she throws it red every night. Ask me the rest when the circle's dead. I'll answer. I keep my word slowly, but I keep it.

It goes to people on this moon who set odds and hate being lied to, with my statement attached. The backrooms exist because the money is invisible. The promoter's own hand makes it visible. I don't need him dead. I need him poor, and famous for the right things. Poor men can't rent pits.

Defeat four members of the Red Bloom Inner Circle in Smuggler's Moon, Fight Club Backrooms. Their defeat secures the Red Bloom Promoter's Payout Chit; bring it back to me here in Smuggler's Moon, Casino.
You've defeated four members of the Red Bloom Inner Circle. Let me see the Red Bloom Promoter's Payout Chit.
Their instructors no longer hold the authority to teach. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the final trial when you're ready.

The master is the last teacher keeping the school alive. Defeat her in the Private Pit. Defeat the Red Bloom Master in Smuggler's Moon, Private Pit. Report back to me here in Smuggler's Moon, Casino; no item is needed for this final trial. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Smuggler's Moon, Private Pit, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Red Bloom Master. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. Once the master is defeated, come back for the final lesson.

You don't out-bloom her. She holds the full form -- the one you're here to earn -- and she spends lives keeping it sharp. So deny her the second cut. The bloom is two cuts agreeing; break the agreement. One of you takes the first, the other two answer before the second opens. She has never fought people who fight for each other. Down there, nobody does.

The best I ever trained, and the only one I ever refused to pass. She asked what I was willing to bleed, the day we met. Same thing I asked you. Her answer was everyone else. I should have ended it there. I gave her footwork instead. This is me paying that debt with your hands, and I know exactly what that makes me.

Then the form has no owner left but the two of us, and I'm retired. The rules come with it, whether you want them or not. You've been keeping them for five bouts already, mostly without noticing. That was the real trial. Her ring is just the last question on it.

Defeat the Red Bloom Master in Smuggler's Moon, Private Pit. Report back to me here in Smuggler's Moon, Casino; no item is needed for this final trial. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Red Bloom Master. Give me your report and we'll finish the trial.
The school is finished. Carry the form with its restraint intact; that matters more than a title. You've earned the right to train Red Bloom. Your final payment is ready.
Let me ask something else.
I'll defeat six Red Bloom Adepts.
What is the Red Bloom?
Whose students are they?
What do you want with their ledger?
I don't have an answer yet.
Here's the Red Bloom Backroom Bout Ledger.
One more question.
I'll defeat five Red Bloom Specialists.
How will the specialists come at me?
Why does the regulator matter to you?
Why did you leave the circuit?
Not yet.
Here's the Red Bloom Ring Shock Regulator.
Back to the gate.
I'll defeat the Red Bloom Warden.
You know him?
Why not go yourself?
Would you recommend bringing help?
I don't have two people I'd trust with this. Not yet.
Here's the Red Bloom Cracked Pit Sigil.
Go back over the four.
I'll defeat four members of the Red Bloom Inner Circle.
What should I know about the four?
Who's in the champion's room?
What happens to the chit after?
Soon. Not tonight.
Here's the Red Bloom Promoter's Payout Chit.
Go over it again.
I'll face the Red Bloom Master and report back.
How do I beat her form?
What was she to you?
And when it's over -- what then?
When my two are ready. Not before.
The Red Bloom Master is defeated. Here's my report.
